# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported                                             |
| ------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| 2.x     | ✅                                                    |
| 1.x     | security fixes (Moderate+) until 6 months after 2.0.0 |

After 2.0.0 is released, the 1.x line receives security fixes for 6 months: fixes rated Moderate and above are
backported to the last 1.x minor; Low ones are fixed in 2.x only. Advisories name both lines.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of ContactFormBundle seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it privately:

- **Email**: hectorfranco@nowo.tech
- **Do not** open a public GitHub issue for security-sensitive bugs.

Please include a minimal reproduction, affected version, and impact assessment when possible.
